description: Free on testnet. Free-text keyword search over the human-verified Ledger (protocols, platforms, wallets, stablecoins). Returns up to 5 matching row NAMES with status, a relevance score and which fields matched (exact_name, name, steward, status, text). It returns names, not answers: call get_status or get_status_detail with a returned name for the verified headline, date and source. No match returns result="none" (never a guess). Example: {"query":"pay per API request for a data feed","limit":3} -> {"result":"found","hits":[{"name":"x402","status":"Live (Limited)","score":9.1,"matched":["text"]}, ...]}.

query.description: Plain-English question or keywords, e.g. 'pay per API request with stablecoins' or 'Visa agent identity'. Max 200 chars.

name: query_ledger
